long-david-liu.text: "I will hold criminals accountable, back the police, and introduce humane but effective solutions to homelessness." Says misguided public safety policies have allowed crime to go unpunished.

long-david-liu.text: "California's rising taxes hurt families and businesses daily... I will fight tax hikes, remove bureaucratic barriers, and put money back in your pocket."

long-david-liu.text: Campaign philosophy at 2024 launch: supports law enforcement being adequately resourced and opposes drastic budget cuts to police departments; wants strict justice for criminals and fewer homeless people; advocates tax reduction for workers and small business owners.
